contract: A TCP proxy closes existing connections and refuses new connections from the separate reader process to one authority. Parent writes continue directly to the actual stores.
The reader reports the affected authority and its recovery code before the parent mutates the other authority.
Cached permission remains valid during the observed partition before the withdrawal.
The healthy authority enforces its withdrawal within two seconds while sixteen workers check cached permission.
After network recovery, a new reader process refuses the withdrawn permission.
